### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

## Creating

## packaging solutions

## for life's essentials.

Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best
performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums,
intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated
recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty
products. 

We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a
wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States.
Greif is strategically positioned in more than 40 countries to serve customers of all sizes and
needs.

## for life's essentials.

Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best
performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums,
intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated
recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty
products. 

We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a
wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States.
Greif is strategically positioned in more than 40 countries to serve customers of all sizes and
needs.

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

# A global energy solutions leader

When General Electric's Distributed Power business came under strategic review in 2018, Advent was a
natural partner. We brought deep sector knowledge, a long track record of complex industrial
carve-outs, and decades of on-the-ground presence across the German-speaking industrial region where
the business is headquartered.

[Ranjan Sen]

"When we successfully carved INNIO out of GE in 2018, we saw an exceptional technology platform that
the world hadn't yet caught up to. Eight years on, INNIO is a fast-growing, highly profitable energy
platform that is well positioned at the intersection of two of the most powerful forces reshaping
global energy: AI and the energy transition.”

Ranjan Sen

Managing Partner, Advent

[INNIO logo]

# A carve-out creating an independent global leader

Carving a business out of one of the world's largest industrial conglomerates requires more than
capital. It requires operational depth and a long-term perspective. Advent's decades of experience
in industrial carve-outs, our hands-on approach to value creation, and our partnership with an
exceptional management team were central to unlocking what INNIO could become as an independent
business.

[INNIO logo]

# Built to meet increasing global power demands

In close collaboration with management and with the support of Advent's Portfolio Support Group, the
team executed a multi-faceted value creation plan across four pillars: deepening the Services
flywheel, capturing the data center opportunity, building a local US manufacturing footprint, and
advancing hydrogen technology.

[INNIO logo]

# The next chapter

Since 2023, total revenues have grown by more than 30% and INNIO entered 2026 with a record
equipment order backlog of $3.6 billion. On June 4, 2026, INNIO listed on the Nasdaq Global Select
Market under the ticker symbol INIO. We are proud of what INNIO's management team, employees, and
our partners have built together.

* Experience with automated parts feeding

If you need a reliable plastic product packaging supplier, you've come to the right place! Munot
Plastics is a leading manufacturer of thermoformed packages such as clamshells, plastic blisters,
and trays. We've offered custom packaging and design [services][35] since 1963 and are here to help
you create the perfect package for your product.

packaging to customer specifications. Compared to similar product packaging suppliers, our
[packaging production lead time][36] gets your packages to you faster.

passionate about their products. All you have to do is provide the carton dimensions, and we will
give you several options to choose from. Then, you pick the options that best meet your needs.

## Sustainability

We believe in sustainability, so much that it is part of our company mission and vision. Our
sustainability initiatives can be found throughout our facilities from electricity savings to water
recycling. Our most impactful program is our EcoStar® post-consumer recycled material, that is made
of 75% or more recycled content.

[
Learn More
][29]

## Innovation

Our award winning team brings design elements to each project that utilize unique tool designs,
intricate trim features and achieve elegant functionality from simple open and closing, to
tamper-evident mechanisms. The experience our design team can bring to each project truly sets us
apart as we look to create, design and innovate packaging to protect and enhance your product on
shelf.

Learn More
][30]

## Collaboration

We listen to understand your product and work together to create an award winning design that
highlights your product. Our team will work with you every step of the way to exceed your
expectations from ideation to production. We make sure you, the customer is satisfied.

  high-performing blow molding presses ideally suited for various medical and pharmaceutical
  applications.

Since 1956

# World Class Supplier of Your Tooling & Plastic Needs

The Plastek Group is a [trusted global supplier][84] of premium quality injection molding tools and
rigid plastic-molded packaging. As an innovative plastics processor, we can provide a [wide range of
targeted solutions][85] that meet your company’s unique challenges. Our 70 years of experience
enable us to serve businesses across a broad spectrum of industries.

[ Request a Quote ][86]
Plastek Locations

# Six Manufacturing Sites Worldwide

The Plastek Group has an international presence with six locations across four countries and three
continents to bring custom plastic manufacturing solutions to where you need them. We have locations
in the US, UK, Mexico and Brazil. Learn more about the unique capabilities at each of our sites.

[ Our Locations ][87]
Join a World-Class Team

# A Job For Today,
# A Career For Tomorrow

That’s what you’ll find when you join the team at Plastek.
[Building careers][88] in the tooling and plastics industry since 1956.
Mold your future with job descriptions matching a wide variety of skill sets.
Advanced Technical positions on our tooling & manufacturing floors, and offices.
Now hiring skilled mold making and manufacturing workers on all shifts.
CNC Specialists, Process Technicians, Automation Technicians, Mold Set Up, and More.
Ask about Plastek’s on the job training, sign on bonus qualifications, and career development.
[Apply for tomorrow’s career][89], today!

[ Explore Careers ][90]
SAVE THE DATES

# Meet The Group

Join us at these [upcoming events][91], and save the dates to meet The Plastek Group during a
variety of networking opportunities. The events we participate in provide a platform for new
business development, fostering connections between industry colleagues, suppliers, vendors, and
customers. Beyond business, we’re dedicated to building awareness within our community, engaging
students, and empowering the workforce. Don’t miss out on these enriching experiences that bring
growth and collaboration to the forefront.

OUR CAPABILITIES & OFFERINGS

## Plastic Manufacturing Capabilities and Fast-Moving Consumer Goods

As full-service plastic packaging suppliers, we can be your [one-stop shop for premium-quality
solutions][98]. Our capabilities include:
* **Package Development:** Our unwavering focus on [research and development][99] makes us an
  innovative plastic design corporation that continually invents the most advanced products.
* **Mold Design/Manufacturing:** Our capable [in-house engineering team][100] will collaborate with
  your company to develop and implement state-of-the-art plastic molded packaging concepts and other
  solutions to give you a competitive edge.
* **Molding/Assembly:** Our [injection molded packaging capabilities][101] include cutting-edge hot
  runner technology that reduces material waste and shortens cycle times. We also have
  high-performing blow molding presses ideally suited for various medical and pharmaceutical
  applications.

You’ll also find numerous stock packages that serve a wide range of packaging applications. Choose
from an assortment of jar caps, straight and round base jars, and oval, round, and gel soft/solid
propel/repel sticks.

## End-to-End Packaging Solutions

PTI is the only plastics packaging partner global brands rely on for fully integrated, lab-to-market
services. We’re constantly reimagining smart packaging and waste-reduction strategies, simulating
packaging performance and prototyping plastics that elevate consumer experience.

Our multidisciplinary team includes material scientists, engineering experts, sustainability
specialists and product support staff. Together, we collaboratively guide plastics projects from
conception and testing to design and delivery. And we’re intently focused on reducing cost,
squeezing out inefficiencies, reducing waste and accelerating speed to market.

PTI, a global leader in packaging innovation and material science, is celebrating its 40th
anniversary this year. Founded in 1985 in Toledo, Ohio, PTI has  grown from a regional packaging
engineering firm into a trusted partner for some of the world’s most recognized brands. Over the
past four decades, PTI has helped lead the evolution of packaging with a strong focus on sustainable
materials, medical packaging, barrier technologies and functional design.

Welcome to www.renewable-carbon.eu, the website showcasing nova-Institute’s many services around
renewable carbon: the bio- and CO2-based economy as well as chemical recycling. nova-Institute is a
science-based research and consultancy company. Organiser of leading expert conferences, workshops
and webinars.

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

([www.cellulose-fibres.eu][43]), Conference on CO2-based Fuels and Chemicals

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

Zenith Eclipse plays a pivotal role in the agricultural and energy sectors. With a strong presence
in over 40 countries, we manage the entire value chain from cultivation and production to global
distribution, international trade, and logistics. Our commitment to excellence ensures seamless
operations, connecting high-quality products with markets worldwide.

From selection to final shipment, we keep a close eye on quality standards at every step. This focus
helps ensure consistent performance, customer satisfaction, and products that support strong results
season after season.

### Strong Distribution and On-Time Delivery

Our distribution network for grains and seeds is built to keep premium products accessible across a
wide range of agricultural markets. With efficient supply chain management, we make sure deliveries

### Sustainable Agriculture

Sustainability is central to how we work. We support farming practices that strengthen integrity,
improve resource efficiency, and help farmers remain profitable—while also protecting soil health
and biodiversity for the future.

### Seed Processing with Purpose

After oil extraction, we turn the remaining seed meal into a valuable, nutrient-rich resource for
both livestock and plants. This approach supports healthier animal feed and helps ensure nothing
goes to waste—using the same strict quality standards applied to our seeds.

and stores seeds to protect quality, viability, and consistency. Backed by a global supply network,
we source from multiple regions and manage shipping efficiently so customers receive high-quality
products wherever they are.
